    About RE/MAX
    RE/MAX of Southern Africa, which was founded in 1995, is regarded as the pioneer of the RE/MAX international expansion as it was the first country franchise to be sold outside of North America. Locally, RE/MAX has over 3,000 agents operating from over 170 offices in 6 countries in Southern Africa.
